role: preparation only: a route-program dataset builder, a leave-one-task-out fitting routine and a zero-oracle comparison harness for a route-distilled PMO program composer. Nothing is wired into any controller and nothing was launched.

inputs.primary_route_corpus_role: frozen training-only dependency-region corpus; it already collects every PMO curriculum route plus the winner curriculum and the public perindopril witnesses

what_counts_as_successful.definition: a route whose recorded primitive trace replays exactly to its recorded terminal endpoint, and whose endpoint is the published task target or a target-known COMPOSE recovery witness
what_counts_as_successful.NOT_oracle_discovered: every route is answer-known. task_scores_loaded is false in the corpus and new_oracle_calls is 0, so none of these is an oracle-discovered search success. They are reconstructions toward a known answer.

route_provenance.interpretation: 184 routes is not 184 independent successes. They collapse to 18 lineages and 7 source molecules, one of which serves 9 of the 11 objectives. Ten of eleven tasks have exactly ONE lineage, so leave-one-task-out is effectively leave-one-lineage-out with n=1, and the held task's source graph is usually the same molecule the training tasks were routed from.

runtime_union_rule.definition: components joined by lifetime-overlap/observed-bond, created-handle producer-consumer, and cycle open/close-restate edges; this is the corpus's own component_count

strict_dataflow_rule.definition: components joined ONLY by created-handle producer->consumer edges; every other primitive is its own region

strict_dataflow_plus_cycle_rule.definition: created-handle producer->consumer plus cycle open/close-restate edges

structural_program_collapse.interpretation: Quoting only the runtime union rule overstates collapse. Under the rule the runtime actually uses, 100% of teacher routes are at most 4 regions (median 1). Under a strict dataflow rule only 5.4% are, at a median of 28 regions. The runtime rule merges on structural adjacency, which is most of the merging: structural_connectivity_edges dominate both other families.

whole_route_extraction.note: extract_structural_goal at its own limits (32 primitives / 4 components) on whole base routes
whole_route_extraction.interpretation: A whole PMO teacher route does not fit the T4 complete-region unit: 7 of 10 abstain, and the one that extracts is a 76-event four-region program, far above T4's large band (>11 events). Windowing is therefore required, and it makes the supervised unit a route SEGMENT, not a whole route.

window_sensitivity.note: measured on the 11 deduplicated curriculum base routes, before the 184-route corpus was adopted
window_sensitivity.interpretation: Cross-task template reuse falls monotonically as the program unit grows. Window 1 reaches 59% only because a one-primitive patch is nearly generic; at any window large enough to be a coordinated multi-region program the shared vocabulary collapses. This is not a window-tuning problem.

verdict.headline: THE ROUTE CORPUS IS TOO THIN TO FIT A TRANSFERABLE PMO PROGRAM PRIOR. Do not fit one for production.
measured_reasons: mean held-task distinct template coverage 0.179 (range 0.043-0.300): 82% of a held objective's teacher patch vocabulary does not occur in the other ten objectives
mean fully expressible held program rate 0.088: 91% of held teacher programs contain at least one template the training fold has never seen, so they are unreachable before any ranking
18 lineages / 7 source molecules / 1 lineage per task for 10 of 11 tasks
cross-task template reuse falls monotonically with program size (0.592 at window 1 to 0.076 at window 6)
what_the_distillation_DID_buy: on the 2 of 11 held tasks where a teacher endpoint was generated at all, the distilled prior ranked it 2nd and 8th against 20th and 20th for the matched uniform arm
the distilled arm proposes markedly more large-scale programs (19-28 of 128 vs 4-12 for uniform) and more remodel-mode programs (8-15 vs 3-4)
why_that_is_not_enough: 2 of 11 tasks is the whole reachable set; on the other 9 neither arm ever generated a teacher endpoint
aggregate shape-match rate is identical (0.732 distilled vs 0.734 uniform), i.e. the weak criterion does not separate the arms
these are window-scale programs (4 primitives, median 10 rewrite events), NOT the ~28-primitive whole teacher routes; the scale shift measured here must not be read as reaching teacher route scale
verdict.consistency_with_the_realization_bottlen: This is independent evidence pointing the same way as the sibling route archaeology. Even granting a perfect ranking over the plan vocabulary, 91% of held-objective teacher programs are not in the vocabulary at all, so sharpening the choice among available plans cannot be where the mass is. Nothing here measures the binding gate, and nothing here should be read as evidence about it.

latent_defect_found_not_fixed.symptom: TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'NoneType' and 'tuple'
latent_defect_found_not_fixed.cause: the source_order sort key includes _signature(target, final_token_slots.get(token)), which is None whenever that source role is RELEASED by the program; Python cannot order None against the tuple returned for a retained role
latent_defect_found_not_fixed.status: NOT FIXED. src/compose_v4/control/ is pinned by content hash into sealed contracts and a scored PMO relaunch is imminent, so the dataset builder catches TypeError and abstains, recording it as abstained_extractor_typeerror. Any future fix is a deliberate process revision, not an incidental patch.
latent_defect_found_not_fixed.consequence_for_this_report: 8.7% of route windows are silently absent from the corpus, and they are not a random 8.7%: they are windows containing atom releases, so prune- and remodel-mode programs are under-represented by an unknown amount. Every mode distribution here inherits that bias.
